name: Tally
promise: A habit tracker that fits in one tap a day.
audience: People who have quit three habit apps already. Watching in a feed, mostly muted.
voice: Plain and warm. Short sentences, second person, no exclamation marks, no productivity jargon.
proof: Tally is a fictional demo brand: no customers, numbers or quotes exist, so none may appear on screen.
